rows.en: Huh? Well, that's...
rows.notes: Both genders; answers Hilda's 'feel free to invite me'.

rows.en:
I told you, looking out for my students is my job.
On duty or off, I'll take proper care of you.
Be grateful.
Oh, okay. Thank you very much!

Mm, good. Now, let's call it a day.
See you.
(Ah, Hilda-sensei, what about the bill...)
rows.notes: Male only; Hilda said 'my treat' but leaves without paying.

rows.en:
(All right, time to fire myself up and work hard
today too... Oh, it's Hilda-sensei.)

No, I just got here...
Oh? Hilda-sensei, you're not in your tracksuit today...

Oh, really? So that's why you're in regular clothes today.
Then maybe I'll head home today too...
Huh? Oh, okay!
Oh, okay!

Okay, thank you!
Then, um, a milk tea and a strawberry shortcake...
But you said 'whatever I like'...
Oh, then I'll have the same.

Oh, is that what it was? I'm sorry.
But you really don't need to worry about me that much!
(That seems like a bit of a leap...)
rows.notes: Female only; reacts to Hilda's life-or-death example.

rows.en:
Besides, kids your age should be itching to have fun.
Don't you even have a boyfriend?

Well, sadly, there's no one I could really call
a boyfriend...
Okaaay, I'm sorryyy...
Oh, okay! Thank you very much!
(Ah, Hilda-sensei, the bill!)
(All right! Today I'm definitely doing some training!)

Huh, Sensei?
You're not in your tracksuit today either...

It's no good doing nothing but training.
We're unwinding again today, understood?
Thanks for the treat, Sensei!
Well, once in a while is fine.
Once again, I'm counting on you from here on!
rows.notes: Both genders; formal 'aratamemashite, kongo mo yoroshiku'.

rows.en: Mm, indeed.
rows.notes: x4: Hilda here, also Klan in frd_kln_004; neutral.

rows.en: (Hilda-sensei is surprisingly kind, you know...)
(All right! Today I'm definitely doing some training!)

Oh, Sensei?
You're not in your tracksuit today either...
(Hilda-sensei is surprisingly kind, you know...)

(I promised to go out with Hilda-sensei again today.
Does this count as a date...?)
Oh, \p-kun, sorry I'm late~
rows.notes: Hilda, male version only; a joke, she imitates a girl arriving for a date (female version c05866 uses -chan).

rows.en: Huh?! S-Sensei...?!
Just kidding. Come on, let's go.
(I never know how to react to Sensei's jokes...)
Still, it's a strange thing, us doing this.
Huh? What do you mean?

Teacher and student. It's not that we have no ties,
but I don't have any other student
I meet up with outside like this.

That's true.
I wonder how we look to other people?
Well, teacher and student. What else could it be?
...Well, I guess so...
Ah, there's that too.
Huh?! What is it?

We could pass for big sister and little brother.
In fact, that's more realistic.
Well, I suppose so...
Oh, wait here a moment.
(What's she up to...?)
Sorry to keep you waiting. Here, eat.
Is this... a hot dog?
Well... yes. Bite into it like a man!
rows.notes: Hilda, both versions; the female player answers 'I'm a girl, though' (c05869).

rows.en: Yes, understood. One big bite!
(Oh, it's tasty. The sausage is so juicy...)
(Yeah, the veggies are nicely balanced too.)

(And the sauce has just the right kick...
the right kick...)
rows.notes: Both genders; 'piri-kara' (pleasantly spicy) repeated as the heat sets in.
x4, three ellipsis characters; also frd_she_008.

rows.en: HOOOOOOT!!!
Ah-ha-ha-ha!
Sensei, it burns! Water! Water!
Hee-hee! Hee-heee!
Sensei, stop laughing and get me water! Water!
Hah, hah... Ah, sorry. Here.

*Gulp, gulp* Pwah!
I thought my throat was on fire! That was mean, Sensei!

No, sorry. Someone pulled the same thing on me
long ago... and...
I just...
rows.notes: Hilda; trails off as the Japanese does ('chotto...').

rows.en: ...Sensei.
Sensei?!
Did something happen back then? With someone...?

No, it's something I've already forgotten. Never mind.
Come on, hurry up and eat. We're off to the next place.
(I wonder what happened back then...)
Right, this is where today's unwinding ends.
(We sure went to a lot of places.)
No, it's nothing.
...Nice view here, isn't it?
Oh, yes, it is!

It's a place where you can forget everything
aboard the Macross, even if only for a moment...
That's what this place is...
rows.notes: Hilda. 'Makurosu kannai' kept literally as 'aboard the Macross' (the colony ship the campus is on).

rows.en:
If we keep getting through each day like this,
I'm sure someday we'll find our own planet...
rows.notes: Hilda; the colony fleet's search for a home planet.

rows.en: Yes, someday, I'm sure.

And in the meantime, how many times
will people meet, and then part...?
Huh... Sensei?!

uncertain: c05856: Hilda says 'Makurosu kannai' (inside the Macross); kept as 'aboard the Macross' rather than naming Frontier.
c05837 '.........' and c05833 '...': ellipsis-only rows rendered at three dots per ellipsis character (c24442 does the same; c00059 uses six dots for five).
c05813: male-only line where Hilda jokingly plays a girlfriend arriving for a date ('\p-kun, sorry I'm late~'); -kun kept as in the Japanese.
